execution_model.description: Extract only the BRD facts needed for an explainable delivery estimate.

global_rules: Use only information explicitly supported by the current BRD knowledge base.
Do not invent workflows, screens, APIs, integrations, data changes, security controls, or test activities.
Preserve source IDs and terminology where supplied.
Return an empty array when no matching source-supported items exist.
Every source_reference must identify evidence for that item.

queries.question: Extract every explicit business rule, decision rule, validation rule, policy, threshold, or condition in the BRD that could affect implementation effort.
rules: Do not convert ordinary requirements into business rules.

queries.question: Extract every Future State Business Requirements mentioned in the document .

Extract every explicit functional requirement from the BRD. Capture the requested capability, actor when stated, workflow or trigger when stated, integrations or APIs when stated, and source reference.
rules: Do not infer screens, APIs, or workflow steps from a requirement title.

queries.question: Extract every explicit non functional requirements mentioned in the document .
rules: Do not infer non-functional requirements from normal functional behavior.

queries.question: Extract every explicit acceptance criteria mentioned in the document.
rules: Do not generate new Given When Then criteria when the BRD does not provide them.
Keep criteria separate from business rules.
